newsitem.title: FRANCE: Suez Lyonnaise sees 1997 net above 3.5 bln ffr.
newsitem.headline: Suez Lyonnaise sees 1997 net above 3.5 bln ffr.

text.p: The merger Suez Lyonnaise des Eaux company expects a 1997 net profit of at least 3.5 billion francs ($604.5 million), Lyonnaise des Eaux and Cie de Suez said in a statement announcing their merger plan.
The company said it aimed to double its earnings per share in five years' after 1997.
"For the 1997 year, the outlook for the net profit for Suez Lyonnaise des Eaux is for a figure of over 3.5 billion francs," the statement said.
"Beyond this year (1997) the objective is to double the net earnings per share in five years," the joint statement said.
Through the merger, the shareholders of the new group will benefit from an immediate positive effect on net earnings per share of eight percent on the 1997 results, it said.
The new company will have a solid financial structure with a gearing of net debt to shareholders funds of 46 percent.
The shareholders will benefit from "an improvement in the quality of results in terms of visibility and recurring profits," the statement said.
